title: fix(organizations)!: retire claimOrphanOrgRows — the first organization no longer adopts organization-less rows
body:
Fixes #25204

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

The build of decision A (retire) on #25204, from the measurement os-dev-report 6342754850 and the seat's decision 6342853688.

## What changes

- **`claimOrphanOrgRows` is retired.** `packages/plugins/organizations/src/claim-orphan-org-rows.ts` and its test (8 mock-engine cases) are deleted. In `organizations-plugin.ts`, Middleware B's "Fallback A" is removed together with its `claimed N orphan seed row(s) for first organization` log line, and header item 2b is replaced by a statement of why both retired paths (the donor clone and the orphan claim) must not come back. The false "Idempotent: a no-op once an organization-tagged row exists" sentence lived only in the deleted file's header.
- **The organization count read is gone.** It existed only to pick Fallback A (`limit: 2` on `sys_organization`). A first organization with no seed replay now logs the same "starts empty" line every later organization already logs.
- **The export** `claimOrphanOrgRows` leaves `@objectstack/organizations`'s `index.ts`, and its README row goes with it.
- **Regenerated, never by hand:** `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` (`node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`: the deleted test's row lost, the new pin's row added) and the tenant-audit census (`node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`: the `claim-orphan-org-rows.ts` row leaves `counts.md`, 237 sites become 236). The census page's hand-written prose counts were restated to match, as `check-tenant-audit-census` requires (the historical carried figures in the first column are left as quoted).
- **Prose, five sites:** `claim-org-seed-ownership.ts` header, `org-scoping-engine.ts` header, plugin-security `claim-seed-ownership.ts` header, `security-plugin.ts` (which also named the retired `cloneOrgSeedData`), and the runtime `app-plugin.ts` passage that quoted the plugin-security header (reworded rather than left quoting text that no longer exists).
- `claim-org-seed-ownership.ts` changes in its header prose only. No ceremony change, no `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_SHAPE_GENERATION` change.

## Pins

`packages/plugins/organizations/src/first-organization-orphan-rows.pin.test.ts`, against the real plugin's Middleware B over an in-memory engine whose `update()` opens with `assertEngineUpdateDispatch`:

- CONTROL: the store holds no organization and three organization-less application rows the probe sees.
- With no seed replay, creating the first organization leaves all three rows NULL and calls no `update`.
- With a seed replay, the first organization gets the app's seed row (the replay ran once, for the new organization) and the organization-less rows stay NULL.
- `claimOrgSeedOwnership` still re-owns exactly the rows the replay reported, and touches no organization-less row.

**Ablation** (Fallback A put back through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with `claim-orphan-org-rows.ts` restored from `origin/main` under a trap; marker count 1 on disk before the run; restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`): `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`, the failure being the seedless case, `expected [] to deeply equal [ 'crm_account:acc_orphan', …(2) ]`: the claim wrote all three rows. The replay case stays green under the ablation by construction (the claim ran only when the replay landed nothing).

## Changeset

`@objectstack/organizations` `patch`, with a BREAKING banner, the FROM/TO line for the retired export, and the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired @objectstack/organizations#claimOrphanOrgRows)`.

## Acceptance notes

- Local proof (package tests, typecheck, derived gates, R1/R4 boots and the upgrade-harness legs) is recorded with commands and exit codes in the os-dev-report on #25204.
- `check-governed-merges --branch`: 0 of 15 paths hit the register, not governed; 691 changed lines.
